verdict.rationale: LM Studio has no documented native bulk or batch feature. Its REST API is meant for use 'from your own apps and scripts', and the `lms` CLI plus the headless llmster daemon could let a user script loops over many items, such as batch inference or loading and downloading many models. That makes bulk work possible only with user-built scripts. Missing for 10: a native batch inference or bulk-processing endpoint, multi-select bulk actions in the app (e.g., bulk delete or move of models or chats), CLI commands that act on many items at once, and any hands-on evidence of bulk workflows.
